function.name: Movies_1_FindMovies

They want to search for movies shown in Napa. They mention "Century Napa Valley and XD". That likely means they want to see movies at those theaters. So we should set theater_name to "Century Napa Valley" or "XD"? But the function only accepts one theater_name. We could do two separate calls? Or maybe we can combine? The user says "I would like to watch at Century Napa Valley and XD." That might mean they want to see movies at both theaters. We could call FindMovies twice: once for each theater. Or we could ask clarifying question. But the instruction says we should not ask clarifying questions unless necessary. We can interpret that they want to search for movies at both theaters. So we can call FindMovies twice.

But the function signature: theater_name?: string, default: "dontcare". So we can pass theater_name: "Century Napa Valley" and then again "XD". But we can't pass multiple values. So we need to call twice.

Also, the user didn't specify genre or show_type. So we can leave them unspecified.

Thus we call:

Movies_1_FindMovies({"location":"Napa, CA","theater_name":"Century Napa Valley"}) and then again with theater_name:"XD".
